chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever keeps hair should take good care of it, or else cut it short."

key_terms.فَلْيُحْسِنْ: then let him do well or maintain properly
key_terms.وِلَايَتَهُ: its care, upkeep, and proper management

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about keeping and caring for hair?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches personal cleanliness and proper grooming as part of refined conduct. It instructs that if a person keeps hair, they should maintain it well; otherwise, they should shorten it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.326 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever grows their hair should take good care of it or cut it short."
